strings.support.title: Support
strings.support.subtitle: Create a diagnostic ZIP and attach it to your GitHub issue.
strings.support.contents: Includes session logs, selected settings, mod versions, and the latest available crash dump.
strings.support.privacy:
Text logs filter account and computer names, personal paths and credentials.
Saves, game files and screenshots are excluded.

strings.support.describe: Describe what happened and how to reproduce it.
strings.about.title: About
strings.about.summary: OpenShao runs Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks natively on PC through static recompilation of the original Xbox game. It includes no game files: you play with your own copy.
strings.about.license: OpenShao is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. The license does not cover the original game's code, assets, names or artwork. It is built with the components below. Their full license texts are in the licenses folder of every release and of the project repository.
strings.game.subtitle: Use your own copy of the original USA/Europe Xbox release.
strings.game.file_detail: An ISO, XISO or ZIP image, or default.xbe. ZIP files are imported into your data folder.
strings.game.folder_detail: The complete folder that contains default.xbe. OpenShao reads it in place.
strings.game.missing_xbe: The saved game folder does not contain default.xbe. Choose your complete game folder or image.

strings.dev.title: Developer
strings.dev.subtitle: Test texture pictures from a folder, without building a pack.
strings.dev.toggle_hint: Test texture pictures from a folder (adds a Developer page)
strings.dev.hint: Choose the folder where the extraction tool put the pictures.
strings.dev.pictures_no_manifest: {count} pictures, and no manifest: every picture will count as edited.
strings.dev.p1: The game reads the pictures in this folder when it starts, before the texture mods you turned on. Only a picture whose pixels differ from the extraction counts, so a single changed pixel is enough and the ones you did not touch are left alone.
strings.dev.p2: Nothing is compressed in this mode. When the textures are ready, build the pack in the mods tool.
strings.dev.p3: Restart the game to see a change. The game's log says how many pictures it found and how many it uses.
strings.dev.choose_dialog: Choose the folder of texture pictures
